rationale: This is essentially cash-based operating profitability (Ball-Gerakos-Linnainmaa-Nikolaev) in crude binary form, and the INDICATOR gate collapses roughly half the universe to exactly zero, creating a huge mass point that destroys clean quantile sorting and makes the short leg an uninterpretable mix of unprofitable and merely cash-unconfirmed firms.

The double ratio scaled by ABS(oibdp/at) explodes for near-zero-profitability firms so the accrual-share rank is dominated by a denominator artifact rather than accrual intensity, and stripped of that noise the signal is just the accruals anomaly conditioned on profitability.

It reconstructs cash-based operating profitability almost line-for-line (gross profit less receivable/inventory build plus payables), and the sign is likely inverted because Compustat recch/invch/apalch are cash-flow-statement impacts (negative when receivables/inventory rise), so NEG(...) rewards exactly the working-capital buildup the hypothesis wants to penalize.

Conditioning a profitability *trend* rather than a level on working-capital accrual financing is a defensible and reasonably clean AND-gate that is not a direct restatement of Sloan or of cash-based profitability, though it remains a composite of two well-known ingredients and the rank-product's low end conflates deteriorating-profit firms with high-accrual firms.

The accrual-volatility ingredient adds a genuinely distinct earnings-quality dimension beyond accrual level, but the three-way composite with a 5-year VOL window makes attribution difficult and will cut coverage, so it needs an ablation against the simpler MA-profitability × low-accrual version to justify itself.

Multiplying two second differences of annual accounting data compounds measurement noise, and the rank product is near zero whenever either component is low, so the "long" leg pools decelerating-earnings firms with clean-accrual growers and the tested spread will not isolate the stated accrual-fueled-surge mechanism.
